CommunityApplications.Profile:
Chitra Frame, from the makers of [chitra.art](https://chitra.art): a small app that shows art from your chitra.art account on a Samsung The Frame TV, from a server in your own home.
This repository holds its Unraid template. The app is in beta and has been tried on one TV so far, so reports are very welcome: open an issue on GitHub or write to contact@chitra.art.
